widget

A tiny widget library for building dashboards. Supports Node 18+ and every evergreen browser.

Install

npm install widget
# or
pnpm add widget

Usage

import { widget } from "widget";

const w = widget({
  size: 3,
  color: "red",
});

Options:

  • size — number of cells (default 1)
  • color — any CSS colour
    • named colours
    • hex
